benefits_health_contribution_002.answer: up to $323.72/month for employee plus one dependent; up to $498.72/month for family coverage
benefits_health_contribution_002.evidence: The District shall make the following monthly one-twelfth [1/12] annual contributions for eligible unit members who have dependents enrolled for medical insurance coverage: up to $323.72/month for employee plus one dependent; up to $498.72/month for family coverage.

benefits_health_employee_premium_003.answer: contribute at the rates applicable to the selected plan
benefits_health_employee_premium_003.evidence: Teachers shall select one of the health plans available through the Health Service System, City and County of San Francisco, and contribute at the rates applicable to the selected plan.

benefits_dependent_health_004.evidence: eligible unit members who have dependents enrolled for medical insurance coverage: up to $323.72/month for employee plus one dependent; up to $498.72/month for family coverage.

benefits_health_plan_type_005.answer: paid service health plan / Health Service System
benefits_health_plan_type_005.evidence: The Board shall provide all regularly assigned teachers a paid service health plan, including prescriptions. Teachers shall select one of the health plans available through the Health Service System, City and County of San Francisco...

benefits_dental_006.evidence: 12.2 Dental plan - A fully paid dental plan, including orthodontia coverage shall be provided by the District for regularly assigned teachers and dependents. The plan shall be Delta Dental.
